content.text: INTAKE OF STUDENTS OF THE ACADEMIC YEAR 2022/2023 ONLY

items: Mention the results obtained (E, D+, D, or C-) for each course unit separately with the relevant academic year. If you have been absent for the module mention it as 'AB', if you have obtained the approval for the medical application, mention it as 'MED', if the results are withheld, mention it as 'WH'.
Follow mentioned amount should be deposited to the Peoples Bank, Dalugama Branch, Account Name: University of Kelaniya, Account No: 055-100130667553.

rows: 2nd, 3rd Medical of the same course unit
columns: Amount to be paid for a course unit

items: The duly filled application, copy of the medical application approved letter and the copy of the payment receipt should be attached and should be handed over to the help desk of the Faculty of Science.
The student requests to sit exams beyond 5 years should obtain the approval of the Appeals committee and attach the letter of approval.
